additional_regressions.expected_behavior: A genuinely installed vulnerable package stays actionable; deployment scope filtering must not hide it.
Development/CI can intentionally assess installed dev tools with explicit dev provenance; local source checks remain usable offline.
An expected env location or0600 mode does not excuse credentials committed to Git or publicly exposed; preserve evidence without retaining secret values.
Valid inherited public construction continues to pass; unknown ancestry is not invented as a private constructor.
Valid absolute timestamps, timezone offsets and calendar boundaries retain correct age semantics.
Built-in development/prelaunch templates run in their qualified source scope with no production-only checks added to development.
ASVS/PCI definitions and source-family profiles remain unchanged; importer and agent snapshots preserve historical identity.
Source and both PHAR variants agree; default overview stays quiet for collection gaps, with structured coverage and exit distinctions preserved.
